description_en: Queries a list of deployment packages. This operation is equivalent to viewing a list of deployment packages on the Deployment Packages page of the DataWorks console
description_zh: 查询发布包列表信息。该功能与DataWorks控制台任务发布页面的发布包列表功能对应
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-deployments --project-identifier dw_project --project-id 10000 --creator 200300000 --end-create-time 1593877765000 --executor 20030000 --end-execute-time 1593877765000 --status 1 --keyword hello --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDeployments

parameters.help_en:
The name of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace page to obtain the workspace name.

You must configure either this parameter or the ProjectId parameter to determine the DataWorks workspace to which the operation is applied
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的名称。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间名称。

该参数与ProjectId参数，二者必须设置其一，用来确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_identifier

parameters.help_en:
The DataWorks workspace ID. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace page to obtain the workspace ID.

You must configure either this parameter or the ProjectIdentifier parameter to determine the DataWorks workspace to which the operation is applied
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。

该参数与ProjectIdentifier参数，二者必须设置其一，用来确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account used by the user who creates the deployment packages
parameters.help_zh: 发布包创建者的阿里云用户ID
parameters.name: creator

parameters.help_en: The time when the deployment packages to be queried are created. This value must be a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 生成发布包的最大毫秒时间戳
parameters.name: end_create_time

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account used by the user who runs the deployment packages
parameters.help_zh: 发布包执行者的阿里云用户ID
parameters.name: executor

parameters.help_en: The time when the deployment packages are run. This value must be a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 发布包开始执行的最大毫秒时间戳
parameters.name: end_execute_time

parameters.help_en:
The status of the deployment packages. Valid values:

0: The deployment packages are ready.
1: The deployment packages are deployed.
2: The deployment packages fail to be deployed.
6: The deployment packages are rejected
parameters.help_zh:
发布包当前的状态。取值如下：
0：发布包已准备就绪。
1：发布包发布成功。
2：发布包发布失败。
6：发布包被驳回
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The keyword that is contained in the names of the deployment packages. A fuzzy search is supported. After you enter a keyword, all deployment packages whose names contain the keyword are displayed
parameters.help_zh: 发布包名称的关键字。DataWorks支持模糊匹配，即输入关键字，即可查询包含该关键字的发布包
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_zh: 请求的数据页数，用于翻页
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10条，最大为100条
parameters.name: page_size

Data.description_zh: 满足查询条件的发布包列表数据

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the deployment package was created

Creator.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account used by the user who created the deployment package
Creator.description_zh: 发布包创建者的阿里云用户ID

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the deployment package failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 当发布包执行失败，该参数用于记录错误信息

ExecuteTime.description_en: The time when the deployment package was run. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC

Executor.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account used by the user who ran the deployment package
Executor.description_zh: 发布包执行者的阿里云用户ID

Id.description_en: The deployment package ID. You can call the [GetDeployment]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173950.html） operation to obtain the ID
Id.description_zh: 发布包的ID，您可以根据此ID调用[GetDeployment]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173950.html）接口，获取发布包详情

Name.description_en: The name of the deployment package

Status.description_en:
The status of the deployment package. Valid values:

0: The deployment package is ready.
1: The deployment package is deployed.
2: The deployment package fails to be deployed.
6: The deployment package is rejected
Status.description_zh:
发布包当前的状态。取值如下：
0：发布包已准备就绪。
1：发布包发布成功。
2：发布包发布失败。
6：发布包被驳回

PageNumber.description_zh: 请求的数据页数，用于翻页

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 满足条件的数据总条数

RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于出现错误后排查问题
